body: ＊本次為 08/07–08/08 兩日合併掃描：08/07 排程未執行（該日無發布），已一併回補。新增 3 則科學文獻。Movement Disorders（洛克斐勒大學）以人類死後腦組織檢驗 SCA3 病人普金氏細胞內的突變 ATXN3 CAG 重複是否隨年齡持續擴增，結果為擴增幅度極小、與小腦顆粒細胞相當且比紋狀體神經元穩定，作者認為體細胞重複擴增不足以解釋普金氏細胞的選擇性退化——若在更大樣本重現，代表亨丁頓舞蹈症近年最熱的「抑制體細胞擴增」路線（如鎖定 MSH3）在 SCA3 的理論基礎較弱，相對之下 Vico VO659 這類直接降低突變蛋白的路線機轉正當性更穩固。Nature Cell Biology（聖猶達兒童研究醫院）發表合成基因調控分子 SynGR1，結合 frataxin 基因內重複序列並招募 BRD4，讓 RNA 聚合酶 II 穿越抑制性 HP1 凝聚體、在甲基化標記仍存在下重啟 FXN 表現（細胞層級、無動物或人體資料）；此為共濟失調圈層出現的新模態類別，但須標明機轉界線——Friedreich's 是功能喪失、polyQ 型 SCA 是功能獲得，「叫醒基因」的策略無法直接移植。Cortex（法國里爾大學）比較健康對照、帕金森氏症與 SCA 三組的節律引子效應，規律節律在三組皆縮短語音起始時間，提示語音起始時間可能是比整體構音評分更敏感的量化指標，對次要終點與數位語音生物標記設計有參考價值。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢兩日內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層 08/07 的兩筆更新分別為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史研究與小腦深部腦刺激試驗（NCT07752095，神經調節），依收錄準則皆不予收錄。另記一筆查核以免日後重複誤判：SBMA 查詢回傳的 NCT07190300「TulmiSTAR-02」（Ph1/2、收案中）逐筆核對後確認為 Novartis 的 tulmimetostat 併用 darolutamide 治療轉移性荷爾蒙敏感性前列腺癌，非 SBMA，屬手冊已載明的雄性素受體同義詞擴展汙染。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL、IntraBio、Solid Biosciences）未見近 7 天內的新事實；搜尋結果中出現的新潟大學 L-arginine SCA6 試驗（48 週 SARA 差異未達統計顯著，p=0.0582）為 2024/12 舊聞，不予收錄。

en.body: *This is a combined 07–08 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 07 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. Three papers added. Movement Disorders (The Rockefeller University) used human post-mortem brain to test whether the mutant ATXN3 CAG repeat keeps expanding inside the Purkinje cells of people with SCA3; the expansion proved minimal — comparable to cerebellar granule neurons and more stable than striatal neurons — leading the authors to conclude that somatic repeat expansion does not account for the selective loss of Purkinje cells. If it replicates in larger samples, it implies the rationale is weak in SCA3 for the route currently hottest in Huntington's disease, suppressing somatic expansion via targets such as MSH3, and correspondingly firmer for lowering the mutant protein directly, as Vico's VO659 does. Nature Cell Biology (St. Jude Children's Research Hospital) reports the synthetic gene regulator SynGR1, which binds the repeat DNA inside the frataxin gene and recruits BRD4 so RNA polymerase II can traverse the repressive HP1 condensates, restoring FXN expression while the methylation marks remain (cell-based only; no animal or human data). It marks a new modality class in the ataxia ring, but the mechanistic boundary must be stated: Friedreich's ataxia is a loss of function while polyglutamine SCA is a gain of function, so waking a silenced gene does not transfer across. Cortex (Univ. Lille) compared rhythmic priming across healthy controls, Parkinson's disease and SCA; regular rhythms shortened speech initiation time in all three groups, suggesting speech initiation time may be a more sensitive measure than a global articulation score — relevant to secondary endpoints and digital speech biomarkers. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials across the two days: the two SCA-ring updates on 07 August were an NEI natural history study in SCA7 and a cerebellar deep brain stimulation trial (NCT07752095, neuromodulation), neither of which meets the inclusion criteria. One verification is logged to prevent the same misreading later: NCT07190300, "TulmiSTAR-02" (Ph1/2, recruiting), returned by the SBMA query, was checked record by record and is Novartis's tulmimetostat combined with darolutamide in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, not SBMA — the androgen-receptor synonym-expansion contamination already documented in the operating manual. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL, IntraBio, Solid Biosciences) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days; the Niigata University L-arginine trial in SCA6 that appeared in search results (48-week SARA difference not statistically significant, p=0.0582) dates from 2024/12 and was not recorded.

body: 臨床試驗雷達補收安基生技 AJ201 的兩筆試驗——NCT05517603（首次用於病人之 Ph1/2a、n=25、2023/02–2024/04、六家美國站點）與 NCT07549919（2026/04 之健康受試者食物效應／PK 試驗，收日本裔與白人男性各半）。此二筆先前未在雷達內，安基的公司情報卡試驗欄因而長期為空，今日補齊。漏收原因值得記錄：前者條件欄雖登記 SBMA，但自 2024/08 起未再更新，依「最後更新日新→舊」排序的例行掃描永遠排不進前 40 名；後者條件欄登記為「健康男性受試者」而非 SBMA，任何以疾病為條件的查詢都查不到。掃描程序已據此新增「已知資產藥名點名查核」每週一次，以補疾病條件查詢的盲區。另新增 1 則科學文獻：Brain Communications 發表兩株新的重組新表位抗體 1B12 與 11G2，用於偵測 HTT1a（CAG 擴增造成異常剪接而生的高致病性聚集蛋白），在小鼠模型上以 HTRF／MSD 平台勝過現行標準抗體 MW8；CAG 擴增驅動的異常剪接是 polyQ 疾病（含 SCA1/2/3/6/7）共通的機轉假說，聚集體定量靈敏度直接決定 Vico VO659 這類 CAG 鎖定療法的臨床前藥效解析度（純小鼠試劑方法學，無人體資料）。另 Molecular Neurobiology 刊出一則 Machado-Joseph 病 citalopram 論文的更正啟事，原文為 2019 年舊作，非新事實，不予收錄。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）當日無新療法型試驗。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL、IntraBio）未見近 7 天內的新事實——Arrowhead 08/04 發布 2026 會計年度第三季財報，全文未提及 ARO-ATXN2 或任何 SCA 項目。⚠️ 發布備註：本日內容推送至版本庫後，GitHub Pages 連續三次建置失敗（13:21、14:40、14:52 UTC，每次跑滿約 10.5 分鐘後逾時；對照 08/05 正常建置僅需 55 秒），姊妹站 MSA-IQ 同時段亦兩次失敗，故本日更新上線時間延後。已查證：全部 16 個資料檔編碼與 JSON 格式皆正常、版本庫僅 19 個檔案共 721KB、GitHub 官方狀態頁顯示 Pages 服務正常，判斷為建置管線側問題而非內容錯誤。您能讀到本則即表示建置已恢復。另本日將頁首「本週新增」KPI 校正回手冊定義（近 7 天內實際新增進文獻／試驗／情報摘要的筆數，經 git 紀錄逐筆核算為 7 筆）；先前數值口徑較寬、含七月下旬平台建置期的批次補錄，數字下降屬口徑校正，非系統停擺。

en.body: Two AnnJi Pharmaceutical trials of AJ201 were backfilled onto the trial radar — NCT05517603 (first-in-patient Ph1/2a, n=25, 2023/02–2024/04, six US sites) and NCT07549919 (a 2026/04 food-effect and PK study in healthy Japanese and White male volunteers). Neither had been on the radar, which is why the trials panel of AnnJi's company card had been empty; both are now recorded. The reason they were missed is worth noting: the first is registered under SBMA but has had no registry update since 2024/08, so a routine scan sorted by most-recently-updated can never reach it within the top 40 results; the second is registered under "healthy male adults" rather than SBMA, so no condition-based query can find it at all. The scanning procedure now includes a weekly asset-name roll-call to cover this blind spot. One paper was also added. Brain Communications reports two novel recombinant neoepitope antibodies, 1B12 and 11G2, for detecting HTT1a — the highly pathogenic aggregation-prone protein produced by aberrant splicing as the CAG repeat expands — outperforming the current standard MW8 antibody on the HTRF and MSD platforms in mouse models. Aberrant splicing driven by CAG expansion is a mechanistic hypothesis shared across the polyglutamine diseases including SCA1/2/3/6/7, and the sensitivity of aggregate quantification sets the resolution at which CAG-directed therapies such as Vico's VO659 can be read preclinically (reagent methodology in mice only; no human data). Molecular Neurobiology also published a correction notice to a citalopram paper in Machado-Joseph disease, but the underlying article dates from 2019 and carries no new fact, so it was not recorded. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) returned no new therapeutic trials today. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL, IntraBio) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days — Arrowhead released its fiscal 2026 third-quarter results on 04 August, and the release makes no mention of ARO-ATXN2 or any SCA programme. ⚠️ Publishing note: after today's content was pushed to the repository, the GitHub Pages build failed three times in a row (13:21, 14:40 and 14:52 UTC, each running about 10.5 minutes before timing out, against 55 seconds for a normal build on 05 August), and the sister site MSA-IQ failed twice over the same period, so today's update went live later than usual. Checks made: all 16 data files are valid UTF-8 and valid JSON, the repository holds just 19 files totalling 721KB, and GitHub's own status page reported Pages as operational — pointing to the build pipeline rather than to any error in the content. If you can read this entry, the build has recovered. The header "new this week" KPI was also recalibrated today to the definition in the operating manual — the number of items actually added to the literature, trial and intelligence feeds in the past 7 days, counted item by item from the git history as 7. Earlier values used a broader basis that included the batch backfills from the platform build-out in late July, so the drop reflects the change of basis, not a stalled system.

body: ＊本次為 08/04–08/05 兩日合併掃描：08/04 排程未執行（該日無發布），已一併回補。新增 2 則科學文獻：BMJ Case Reports 報告一名以頸部肌張力不全表現、症狀出現十年後才確診的 CACNA1A 相關脊髓小腦萎縮症病例（此基因即 SCA6／發作性共濟失調第 2 型，也是 IntraBio 第三期 NCT07221292 的族群，診斷延遲直接影響該圈層的可收案人數）；Stem Cell Research 建立四株 SCA12 病人來源 iPSC 品系（PPP2R2B 非編碼區 ≥43 CAG，屬非 polyQ 亞型、不在 Stemchymal 適應症內）。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）兩日內僅兩筆更新，分別為經顱時間干涉刺激（神經調節，非療法型）與 SCA 自然史研究，依收錄準則不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: *This is a combined 04–05 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 04 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. Two papers added. BMJ Case Reports describes a patient who presented with cervical dystonia and was diagnosed with CACNA1A-related spinocerebellar ataxia only ten years after symptom onset — the same gene behind SCA6 and episodic ataxia type 2, and the population of IntraBio's Phase 3 trial NCT07221292, so the diagnostic delay bears directly on the enrollable population in that ring. Stem Cell Research reports four patient-derived iPSC lines for SCA12 (≥43 CAG in the non-coding region of PPP2R2B — a non-polyQ subtype, outside the Stemchymal indication). The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) returned only two updates across the two days — a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study (neuromodulation, not a therapeutic) and an SCA natural history study — neither of which meets the inclusion criteria. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：Neurological Sciences 綜述長讀定序在神經疾病基因診斷的角色，明列脊髓小腦萎縮症為已展現效益的適應症（大型重複擴增正是短讀定序的盲區），並整理 DNA 品質、分析負荷、成本與可近性等待解限制——與 SCA 試驗的基因型納入與分層條件直接相關。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）本日無清單外的新療法型試驗；Friedreich 圈層近日更新的四筆中，Solid Biosciences SGT-212（NCT07180355）已在追蹤名單內，其餘三筆為觀察性或數位評估研究，不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、仲恩／REPROCELL 等）未見近 7 天內的新事實。今日為週一，已產出週報草稿檔並建立 Gmail 寄件草稿（2026/07/28–08/03，待人工審閱後手動寄出）。

en.body: Added 1 paper. A review in Neurological Sciences sets out the role of long-read sequencing in the genetic diagnosis of neurological disease, listing spinocerebellar ataxia among the conditions where the benefit is already demonstrated (large repeat expansions being precisely the blind spot of short-read sequencing), and collects the outstanding limits around DNA quality, analytical burden, cost and access — all directly relevant to genotype-based eligibility and stratification in SCA trials. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) surfaced no therapeutic trials outside the tracked list today; of the four recently updated records in the Friedreich ring, Solid Biosciences' SGT-212 (NCT07180355) is already tracked and the other three are observational or digital-outcome studies and were not recorded. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Steminent/REPROCELL and others) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days. Being a Monday, the weekly report file covering 2026/07/28–08/03 was produced and a Gmail draft created, awaiting manual review before it is sent.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻：Annals of Neurology 以 ATXN3 敲入小鼠證明 SCA3 的周邊感覺神經病變源自突變 ataxin-3 的毒性功能獲得，且僅在感覺神經元中沉默突變基因即可改善——指出背根神經節是鞘內給藥的基因沉默療法需一併覆蓋的區室；另一則為 medRxiv 預印本，以長讀定序拆解 ATXN2 周邊單體型與 CAA 中斷數的關係（三個中斷在對照族群約 1%、在中間長度重複的 ALS 個案約 55%）。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）本日無清單外的新療法型試驗，既有試驗狀態亦與平台紀錄一致。

en.body: Added 2 papers. In Annals of Neurology, ATXN3 knock-in mice show that the peripheral sensory neuropathy of SCA3 arises from a toxic gain of function of mutant ataxin-3, and that silencing the mutant gene in sensory neurons alone is enough to improve it — arguing that dorsal root ganglia are a compartment intrathecally dosed gene-silencing therapies must also reach. The second is a medRxiv preprint using long-read sequencing to dissect haplotypes around ATXN2 against CAA interruption count (three interruptions being present in about 1% of controls but about 55% of ALS cases with intermediate repeats). The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) surfaced no therapeutic trials outside the tracked list today, and the statuses of tracked trials match what the platform already records.

body: 市場覆蓋矩陣補到零缺口：12 個目標市場的治療型與製造生態系兩層全數有對象。法國原本雙缺，補入 Cell-Easy（土魯斯，CellReady 異體 MSC 平台，2026-01 與 CHU Toulouse 啟動 A-MUSE Ph1/2）、CELLforCURE by SEQENS 與 CellProthera；澳洲補入 Cell Therapies Pty Ltd，該廠已通過 TGA／FDA／EMA／PMDA 查核並持有日本 MHLW 認證，因與本社日本審查時程耦合而列為優先序 1；瑞典補入 CCRM Nordic（與既有加拿大 OmniaBio 同一組織網絡）與 ATMP Sweden；瑞士補入 Avrion Therapeutics。比利時補入 BioSenic（原 Bone Therapeutics），但誠實標註：其 ALLOB 異體 MSC 於 Ph2b 療效未達而擱置、公司已轉向非細胞資產，該市場治療型層實質上仍是空的。公司層 75→83 家、合作分析 73→81 筆。

en.body: The market coverage matrix now has no gaps: all 12 target markets carry counterparties in both the therapeutic and manufacturing-ecosystem layers. France, previously empty on both, gains Cell-Easy (Toulouse, whose CellReady allogeneic MSC platform entered the A-MUSE Ph1/2 with CHU Toulouse in January 2026), CELLforCURE by SEQENS and CellProthera. Australia gains Cell Therapies Pty Ltd, a site inspected by the TGA, FDA, EMA and PMDA that also holds Japanese MHLW accreditation, ranked priority 1 because its relevance is coupled to the Japanese review timeline. Sweden gains CCRM Nordic, part of the same organisational network as the existing Canadian OmniaBio line, along with ATMP Sweden. Switzerland gains Avrion Therapeutics. Belgium gains BioSenic, formerly Bone Therapeutics, with an honest caveat: its ALLOB allogeneic MSC missed efficacy at Phase 2b and was shelved while the company moved to non-cell assets, so that market's therapeutic layer remains effectively empty. The company layer grew from 75 to 83 and the partnering analysis from 73 to 81 entries.

body: 合作機會頁補齊「學術層」：新增 5 個 SCA 自然史世代聯盟（美國 CRC-SCA／READISCA、台灣台北榮總、歐洲 EUROSCA／RISCA、日本 SCA6、中國 NfL），市場覆蓋地圖中美國與台灣的學術缺口已填上。

en.body: Filled the academic layer on the Partnering tab: added 5 SCA natural-history consortia (US CRC-SCA/READISCA, Taiwan's Taipei VGH, Europe's EUROSCA/RISCA, Japan's SCA6, China's NfL), closing the empty US- and Taiwan-academic cells on the market-coverage map.

body: 新增「合作機會」分頁與市場覆蓋地圖：涵蓋 12 個目標市場、三層對象共 68 家的逐家合作分析。公司層由 45 家擴充至 70 家，補進仲恩既有價值鏈成員（Cyto-Facto、Terumo BCT、Histocell）、台灣 6 家再生醫療同業，以及先前完全空白的國際製造生態系。另查證具名兩筆原本匿名的細胞治療對手：賽萊拉 Sclnow（中國，NCT03378414，Ph2、n=45、涵蓋 SCA1/2/3/6）與全新發現的 Biocells Medical（波蘭，NCT07467733，Ph1/2、n=90、鞘內＋鼻內給藥）——後者因登錄病名寫作 spinocerebellar palsy，先前的關鍵字掃描未命中，掃描條件已據此擴充。⚠️ 合作對象分析原訂維持內部、不上公開站，經重新拍板改為公開發布。 當日第二輪掃描另補收 1 則文獻（Movement Disorders 遺傳性共濟失調分類架構回顧）。

en.body: Added a Partnering tab and a market coverage map: a company-by-company partnering assessment covering 68 companies across 12 target markets and three layers. The company layer grew from 45 to 70, adding Steminent's existing value-chain members (Cyto-Facto, Terumo BCT, Histocell), six Taiwanese regenerative medicine peers, and an international manufacturing ecosystem that had been entirely absent. Two previously anonymous cell therapy rivals were also identified: Sclnow of China (NCT03378414, Ph2, n=45, covering SCA1/2/3/6) and the newly discovered Biocells Medical of Poland (NCT07467733, Ph1/2, n=90, intrathecal plus intranasal) — the latter had been missed because its registry entry names the condition spinocerebellar palsy, and the scan criteria have been widened accordingly. Note that the partnering analysis was originally to be kept internal and off the public site; that decision was revisited and it is now published. A second scan pass the same day added one further paper (a Movement Disorders review of hereditary ataxia classification frameworks).

body: 補收長期漏掉的日本競品 Kissei 橘生製藥 rovatirelin（KPS-0373）之現行樞紐試驗：藥證 2023/07 撤回後重啟的第三次 Ph3 確認試驗已登錄 NCT07040137（日本多中心、隨機雙盲安慰劑對照、n=142、24 週、主要指標 SARA 總分，2025/07 起收案、估 2027/03 主要完成）——同一監管機關、同一主要量表、市場範疇與本社日本承認申請重疊，威脅等級由「低」調整為「中」，並新增競品全景一列、更新公司情報卡與試驗結果讀出。另補收 SCA27B 學術 Ph3（NCT07185347）：法國 AP-HP 以 fampridine（4-AP 緩釋 10mg BID、12 週、n=70、9 中心）治療 SCA27B，與 Solaxa SLX-100 同分子；同步補上 Solaxa 2026/02 與 Alvogen 的全球授權（最高 9,500 萬美元里程碑＋兩位數權利金）。另收 Larimar 兒童 FA 之 Ph1（NCT06681766，登錄狀態「終止」但理由為行政性轉入開放標籤，非安全性問題）。新增 3 則科學文獻：anti-Yo 免疫性小腦退化 vs SCA1 之小腦形態學比較（巴黎腦研究所）、SCA 診斷延遲與五項眼科鑑別線索（墨西哥）、以失智為首發的 SCA17 家族案例與表現型譜回顧。

en.body: Captured the current pivotal trial of a long-missed Japanese competitor, Kissei Pharmaceutical's rovatirelin (KPS-0373): the third Ph3 confirmatory study it restarted after withdrawing its Japanese application in 2023/07 is registered as NCT07040137 (multicentre in Japan, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, n=142 over 24 weeks, total SARA as the primary endpoint, recruiting since 2025/07 with primary completion estimated 2027/03). Same regulator, same primary scale and a market scope overlapping Steminent's Japanese application, so its threat level moves from low to mid; a competitor-landscape row was added and the company card and results readout were updated. Also captured the academic SCA27B Ph3 (NCT07185347), in which AP-HP in France is testing fampridine (prolonged-release 4-AP 10 mg twice daily for 12 weeks, n=70, nine centres) — the same molecule as Solaxa's SLX-100 — and filled in Solaxa's 2026/02 global licence with Alvogen (milestones of up to $95 million plus double-digit royalties). Larimar's paediatric FA Ph1 (NCT06681766) was added as well, noting that its TERMINATED status is administrative — participants moved directly into the open-label study — not a safety issue. Three papers were added: a cerebellar-morphometry comparison of anti-Yo immune-mediated degeneration versus SCA1 (Paris Brain Institute), diagnostic delay in SCA with five ophthalmic differentiating clues (Mexico), and a dementia-first SCA17 family case with a phenotype-spectrum review.

body: 主動發現清單外競品 Solid Biosciences（NASDAQ: SLDB）：Friedreich's Ataxia 基因療法 SGT-212 首次人體 Ph1b（NCT07180355）自 2025/10 收案中，採雙側小腦齒狀核注輸＋靜脈雙途徑遞送——正對應 Biogen BIIB132 折戟的深部小腦遞送難題；已建立競品全景、公司情報卡與試驗各一筆，追蹤競品數 20→21。另補收 PTC Therapeutics 新 Ph3「PROVE-FA」（NCT07681713，n≈120、24 個月、主要指標 mFARS、估 2026/08 起始），惟為單臂開放標籤無對照設計。新增 3 則科學文獻：SCA3 類澱粉聚集抑制（肉桂芽多酚，線蟲模型）、SCA3 認知障礙靜息態 fMRI（n=84）、共濟失調病人自述視功能與眼動關聯（MGH／哈佛）。

en.body: Discovered an off-list competitor, Solid Biosciences (NASDAQ: SLDB): its Friedreich's ataxia gene therapy SGT-212 has been recruiting into a first-in-human Ph1b (NCT07180355) since 2025/10, using dual-route delivery via bilateral cerebellar dentate-nucleus infusion plus IV — aimed at the deep-cerebellar delivery problem that sank Biogen's BIIB132. Added as a competitor-landscape row, a company card and a trial; tracked competitors 20 → 21. Also captured PTC Therapeutics' new Ph3, PROVE-FA (NCT07681713; n≈120 over 24 months, primary endpoint mFARS, estimated start 2026/08), though it is single-arm, open-label and uncontrolled. Added 3 papers: suppression of ataxin-3 amyloid aggregation by cinnamon-bud polyphenols in a C. elegans model, resting-state fMRI in SCA3 with cognitive impairment (n=84), and patient-reported visual function and its oculomotor correlates in ataxias (MGH / Harvard).

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：SCA2 前臨床期辨識的多變量 MRI 模型（Tomography，墨西哥／古巴 Holguín 團隊）——以多項 MRI 線性測量區辨健康對照、ATXN2 前臨床帶因者與已發病者，整體準確率 80.7%（前臨床 AUC 0.75）。五組適應症 CT.gov 掃描（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyQ／CACNA1A）近 7 天無清單外新療法試驗，SBMA 組命中皆為前列腺癌雄性素路徑試驗之字面誤中；本社與 Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead 亦無新監管或臨床動態。

en.body: Added 1 paper: a multivariate MRI model for identifying the preclinical stage of SCA2 (Tomography; Mexican / Cuban Holguín groups) that discriminates healthy controls, preclinical ATXN2 carriers and manifest patients with 80.7% overall accuracy (preclinical AUC 0.75). The five-indication CT.gov sweep (SCA/Friedreich/SBMA/polyQ/CACNA1A) found no off-list therapy trials in the last 7 days — the SBMA hits were all literal false matches from prostate-cancer androgen-pathway studies — and there was no new regulatory or clinical movement from Steminent, Biohaven, Vico or Arrowhead.

body: 新增 4 則科學文獻，其中 MSC 治療小腦共濟失調系統性回顧（CNS Neurosci Ther，韓國慶北大學）直接支持異體策略——共濟失調病人自體 MSC 的抗發炎分泌體能力低於健康捐贈者，且 SCA2 模型症狀後給藥仍見療效；另收 SCA2 N140 電生理生物標記、SBMA 肌肉 MRI 影像生物標記（Neurology）與 polyQ 多系統病理回顧。主動發現清單外競品 Nido Biosciences（NIDO-361，口服 SARM，SBMA／polyQ 鄰域）：Ph2（NCT06411912，n=54）主要終點肌肉 MRI 瘦肌肉體積未見優於安慰劑，2026/03 登錄公告結果，公司於 2026 年初結束營運——已建立競品全景、公司情報卡、試驗與結果讀出各一筆。追蹤競品數 19→20。

en.body: Added 4 papers. The systematic review of MSC therapy for cerebellar ataxia (CNS Neurosci Ther, Kyungpook National University, Korea) directly supports an allogeneic strategy — MSCs from ataxia patients have weaker anti-inflammatory secretome capacity than healthy-donor MSCs, and efficacy in the SCA2 model held even when dosing began after symptom onset. Also added an SCA2 N140 electrophysiology biomarker, an SBMA muscle-MRI imaging biomarker (Neurology) and a review of polyQ multisystem pathology. Discovered an off-list competitor, Nido Biosciences (NIDO-361, an oral SARM in SBMA / the adjacent polyQ ring): its Ph2 (NCT06411912, n=54) showed no advantage over placebo on the primary muscle-MRI lean muscle volume endpoint, results were posted to the registry in 2026/03, and the company wound down in early 2026 — now recorded as a competitor-landscape row, a company card, a trial and a results readout. Tracked competitors 19 → 20.

body: 新增競品試驗 Lexeo LX2006 SUNRISE-FA 2（NCT07721025，AAVrh.10hFXN 基因療法，Friedreich's Ataxia 相關心肌病變，Ph2 註冊型，2026/06/25 啟動、現正收案，主要指標＝心臟 MRI 左心室質量指數變化）；同步更新競品全景中 Lexeo 一列的狀態。五組適應症 CT.gov 掃描（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyQ／CACNA1A）與 PubMed 近 7 天未見其他清單外新競品或新文獻。

en.body: Added a competitor trial, Lexeo LX2006 SUNRISE-FA 2 (NCT07721025, AAVrh.10hFXN gene therapy, Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, Ph2 registrational, started 2026/06/25 and now recruiting, primary endpoint = change in LV mass index by cardiac MRI); the Lexeo row in the competitor landscape was updated accordingly. The five-indication CT.gov sweep (SCA/Friedreich/SBMA/polyQ/CACNA1A) and the 7-day PubMed scan surfaced no other off-list competitors or new papers.
